about: Merchant knowledge for categorization (packages/domain/80-money-answers.js MoneyAnswers.classify and packages/domain/57-agent-ledger.js AgentLedger.categorize): what each merchant actually IS, and therefore which category its charges belong in. Both classifiers consult this file BEFORE their word rules, so knowledge wins over a bare word inside a name (Polymarket is a prediction market, not groceries for the word 'market'); the word rules remain the fallback for merchants not on file, and a person's own category rule (95-category-rules.js) still wins over knowledge. Every entry: the descriptor pattern as data (match, a regex string read at runtime), what the merchant is, its category in each classifier's vocabulary (money_group for chat answers, ledger_category for the ledger), a source note and the day it was checked. Checked 2026-10-12: the hand-labelled entries from the owner's real Chase rows (Jul 15-Oct 9 2026); the well-known entries are the merchants the two tables already hardcoded, moved into data with the same patterns and categories.
